description: This Java class configures a batch job for processing share dividend payments in the Fineract platform. It defines Spring Batch steps, jobs, and tasklets, and injects necessary services for the job execution.

classes.name: PostDividentsForSharesConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up a batch job for processing dividend payments for shares. It uses dependency injection to wire in necessary services and defines beans for step, job, and tasklet.

methods.name: postDividentsForSharesStep
methods.description: Defines a batch step that executes the PostDividentsForSharesTasklet within a transaction.

methods.name: postDividentsForSharesJob
methods.description: Defines the batch job that starts with the share dividends step and uses a job name with a run ID incrementer.

methods.name: postDividentsForSharesTasklet
methods.description: Creates an instance of PostDividentsForSharesTasklet, injecting required services.
